description: This file contains a class definition for the Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach class, which manages foreach loop operations within the Smarty templating engine, including initialization, counting elements, and restoring variable states.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach
classes.description: A runtime class that manages the lifecycle of foreach loops in Smarty templates, including initialization, counting items, and restoring variable states after loop execution.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes foreach loop variables, counts total elements if needed, and manages variable scope within a Smarty template.

methods.name: count
methods.description: [Utility function] Counts elements in arrays, Traversable objects, or PDOStatement objects, supporting different iterable types.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores previous variable states after a foreach loop completes, supporting nested loops or loop control statements.
